title: Quadratic input consistency tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number. The associated Boolean tester uses four query positions and addresses drawn from the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and $2^n+2^{n^2}$ proof positions; it is obtained by extending the affine consistency tester to this address space and padding it to four queries.
caveat: The definitions of the affine consistency tester, address reindexing, and query padding are not supplied, so their precise behavior cannot be described.
